cases.primaryEndpoint: Total PUL2.0 percentage change from baseline at 12 months
cases.reportedEffect: Reported between-group difference +4.55% in PUL2.0 percentage change; 95% CI 0.47 to 8.63; reported p=0.029
cases.analysisPopulation: 106 randomized (deramiocel 54; placebo 52); article abstract describes intention-to-treat
cases.safetyObservation: Authors described a similar safety profile to placebo; full adverse-event denominators not independently reconciled
specificReviewNeeds: Check prospectively locked PUL2.0 definition and endpoint hierarchy
Confirm unblinding date versus original SAP changes and subgroup exclusions
Reconcile all safety arm denominators and available FDA inspection/quality issues

cases.primaryEndpoint: Time to first IgG4-related disease flare requiring rescue therapy
cases.reportedEffect: Hazard ratio 0.44; 95% CI 0.28 to 0.71; reported p<0.001
cases.safetyObservation: Authors reported serious adverse events in 10.3% versus 18.6%; exposure-adjusted denominators still need independent review
specificReviewNeeds: Verify adjudication of flare and rescue-treatment rules
Read protocol and appendix, lock date, multiplicity hierarchy and estimand
Reconcile glucocorticoid taper, missing data and safety exposure

cases.primaryEndpoint: Two primary endpoints: change in peak oxygen uptake and KCCQ-CSS at week 36
cases.reportedEffect: Peak VO2 least-squares difference +0.67 mL/kg/min (95% CI 0.22 to 1.11; p=0.003); KCCQ-CSS +3.0 (95% CI 0.5 to 5.5; p=0.02)
cases.safetyObservation: Authors reported LVEF below 50%: 10.5% vs 0.8%; serious adverse events: 20.2% vs 14.7%
specificReviewNeeds: Verify dual primary statistical gate and adjustment chronology
Review clinical importance of effect size independently of p-values
Reconcile LVEF reduction, serious adverse event counts and exposure

cases.primaryEndpoint: Change in automated office systolic blood pressure at week 6 (lorundrostat 50 mg vs placebo)
cases.reportedEffect: Least-squares between-group difference -9.1 mmHg; 95% CI -13.3 to -4.9; reported p<0.001
cases.analysisPopulation: 1083 randomized (1:2:1); primary comparison uses pooled 50 mg lorundrostat versus placebo; 1078 received treatment
cases.safetyObservation: Hyperkalemia, hyponatremia and eGFR reductions were prespecified adverse events of special interest; denominators and discontinuations require original SAP/exposure review
specificReviewNeeds: Compare protocol versions 2.1, 3.0 and 3.1 with final protocol and database-lock timeline
Audit source supplement 1 eFigure 2 hypotheses H1-H7 and secondary multiplicity paths
Reconcile 1000-imputation treatment-policy estimand, MAR/MNAR assumptions, jump-to-reference sensitivity and missing data
Reconcile potassium, sodium and eGFR arm-specific event denominators

cases.primaryEndpoint: Time to onset of symptom relief during hereditary angioedema attacks
cases.reportedEffect: Median 1.28 h with deucrictibant vs >12 h placebo; reported p<0.0001
cases.analysisPopulation: 134 randomized; 113 treated 201 attacks; efficacy comparison includes 88 patients with paired treated attacks
cases.safetyObservation: Authors reported no severe or serious treatment-related adverse events; attack-based exposure denominators require review
specificReviewNeeds: Verify crossover pair inclusion/exclusion and repeated-attack estimand
Check 12-hour censoring, rescue medication, multiplicity and paired-analysis sensitivity
Separate participant and attack safety denominators
